bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; ROOT=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot; printf 'SERVICE_ACTIVE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true; printf 'SERVICE_ENABLED='; systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true; printf 'CHECKOUT='; test -d "$ROOT" && echo PRESENT || echo MISSING; if test -d "$ROOT"; then git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --short HEAD; find "$ROOT/scripts" -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*userbot*ipc*' -o -iname '*userbot*resident*' -o -iname '*userbot*verify*' \) -printf 'SCRIPT=%f\n' 2>/dev/null || true; fi; printf 'IPC_SOCKETS='; find /run/user/$(id -u) -maxdepth 3 -type s -iname '*userbot*' -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null || true
